test.command: bash -c 'if [ "${OS:-}" = Windows_NT ]; then export LLVM_PROFILE_FILE_NAME=printobserver-octoprint-%p-%m.profraw; fi; if uv run -q python -m repo_checks rust-tests-uninstrumented; then exec cargo nextest run -p printobserver-octoprint --target-dir target/uninstrumented --no-tests=pass -E "not binary(integration)"; fi; exec cargo llvm-cov nextest -p printobserver-octoprint --no-report --no-tests=pass -E "not binary(integration)"'
